How Tekken Force connects

  • Faction: Mishima Zaibatsu — Tekken Force is the Mishima Zaibatsu's private army.
  • Character: Lars Alexandersson — Lars led a Tekken Force rebellion against the Zaibatsu.

What is Tekken Force?

Tekken Force is the Mishima Zaibatsu's private army, used as a world-police in Jin's reign and the unit Lars Alexandersson rebelled from.

Key threads lead to Mishima Zaibatsu and Lars Alexandersson.
